text:
katie: Quick follow-up on the handshake-state refactor RFC — I opened a draft that collapses the old preflight+validate phases into a single explicit 'handshake' state and introduces a terminal 'shed' state with structured reasons. Draft: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/handshake-refactor (WIP).

miguel: sgtm at a high level. main Q: how does this interact with streaming resume tokens? we currently rely on preflight to pin model variant + kv cache window.

katie: good call. plan is: handshake must return a minimal capability tuple: {model_variant, kv_window_id, resume_allowed:boolean}. if resume_allowed=false client gets a non-resumable flag and we attach a short-lived resume_token that will 404 after expiry.

raj: concern: memory accounting. if handshake can allocate kv_window_id we need a bounded promise for allocation. otherwise a flurry of handshakes can OOM GPUs. proposal: attach a small lease window (e.g. 2s) and require allocation completion or handshake fails with 503 + reason=alloc_timeout.

sam: also think we should sanitize streaming headers during handshake (strip sensitive cookies/trace headers, normalise content-length). sample handshake pseudo:
```
POST /handshake -> {headers, auth}
-> validate auth
-> normalize headers
-> allocate kv lease (2s)
-> return capability tuple + resume_token?
```

miguel: +1. one more: for graceful shedding when capacity is low, prefer early explicit rejection with structured trailer over midstream abort. i.e. return 429 with trailer: `x-shed-reason:queue_depth` so clients can fallback immediately.

katie: agree. also we should add idempotency checks at handshake boundary (idempotency-key) to avoid duplicate heavy allocations on retries. if key present and duplicate -> return previous capability or 409 with existing key info.

raj: nit: make the shed reasons enum small: [queue_depth, alloc_timeout, node_drain, auth_retry] — easier for consumers.

deploy-bot: staging rollout of handshake-refactor branch succeeded on canary cluster (canary=2 nodes). tests: handshake time, kv-lease failures, resume token expiry :white_check_mark:

katie: thanks! I'll update the RFC with kv-lease semantics, idempotency-key behavior, trailer format, and add a small compatibility section for old clients. plan: canary 10% prod tomorrow, rollback window 1h. comments on RFC welcome.
